daily_kpi: MET before this additional study — multiple distinct real-data backtests were completed earlier on 2026-11-25
data_scope: FRED SP500, VIXCLS and T10Y3M daily; aligned price coverage 2016-11-28 to 2026-11-24; 415 non-overlapping six-session-spaced origins; validation 2019–2021; test 2022 onward
disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — evidence is mixed, statistically uncertain or insufficient under the frozen decision rule

event_construction.signal_rule: signal-date VIX close; latest T10Y3M observation strictly before signal date; target begins next S&P 500 session

limitations: SP500 is a cash price index, not an executable futures series or total-return index.
T10Y3M is a constructed daily Treasury spread, not a directly traded instrument.
The latest T10Y3M observation strictly before each signal date is used; same-date values are excluded.
The 20-observation curve variation is a simple daily root-sum-square, not the exact term-structure-volatility model in the cited literature.
FRED current-vintage observations were used; historical release vintages were not reconstructed.
Forecasting only: no causal claim, transaction-cost model, tradable strategy or live deployment conclusion.
No raw source data are committed; only hashes, retrieval metadata and aggregate metrics are retained.

methodology.curve_feature: sqrt(sum of squared 20 daily T10Y3M changes in basis points), using 21 observations strictly before the S&P 500 signal date
methodology.target: log1p(next-five-session S&P 500 realized volatility in percent)
methodology.training_rule: training target_end_date must be strictly earlier than current signal_date
